purpose: Close the P0/P1 resource gaps identified in role_capability_depth_audit.md (§5.2) for role_resource_matrix_seed.json. Additive only: no app, workbook, repository, or seed files were modified.
inputs: role_resource_matrix_seed.json (role slugs, flag/tier definitions, evaluation_tasks, scoring_rules)

conventions.flags: core | internal | conditional — same semantics as seed flag_definitions
conventions.tiers: foundational | core | advanced — same semantics as seed tier_definitions
conventions.evidence: E3 = HTTP 200/202 in the 2026-11-20 probe; E2 = blocked (403/SSL/timeout, bot-wall class) or Google-domain SSL interception — recheck-not-replace per audit §7
conventions.supports_eval_tasks: task_type values from each role's evaluation_tasks block in the seed: portfolio_artifact | scenario_simulation | senior_scope_defense

gap_closure_summary.gap: P1 SecOps tooling layer (detection-engineer, soc-security-analyst, threat-intelligence-analyst, vulnerability-management-engineer)

deferred_gaps_not_addressed: P2/P3 gaps from audit §5.2 remain open by design: GTM crafts (support/CS/sales/talent/brand/social), CI-system & cloud-provider practitioner docs (30/31), building codes (architect), CAE theory textbook (90), AM feedstock/NDT (71-73), narrative tooling (58), rigging (80), psychometrics (94). The NIST AI 600-1 stale-link fix and re-probe of the 76 unchecked URLs are separate action-queue items (audit §10, items 3).
